  AUTH: allowed in INIT, READY, ACTIVE, DONE; requires not A. Effects: A=true, go ACTIVE.
  OPEN: allowed in READY, ACTIVE, DONE; requires n >= 1. Effects: A=true, T=true, go DONE.
  PAUSE: allowed in INIT, PAUSED, DONE; requires not T. Effects: n + 2, go READY.
  RESUME: allowed in INIT, PAUSED, DONE; requires T. Effects: A=false, T=false, go DONE.
  TICKET: allowed in READY, PAUSED, FAULT, DONE. Effects: n + 2, go DONE.
  CLOSE: allowed in INIT, READY, ACTIVE, FAULT. Effects: A=true, T=true, go READY.
